title: Keyturn Host Protection Plan: the Host's Damage Report on the Register
content:
When a host reports damage to a vehicle the marketplace protects, the desk settles how many photographs and documents the report must carry, and the host lodges that many with the report. The report is what stands on the damage report register for the trip the damage is attributed to, under the Keyturn Host Protection Plan enrolment covering that vehicle.

### Situation of use and capability

`lodge_damage_report_2cc23be4` puts a fresh report on the damage report register for a named trip, marks it routed for the protection team with the stated number of photographs and supporting items attached, and stamps it with the moment it was lodged. The host can afterwards see the report and its reference on the register against that trip.

### How it is invoked

The tool is unlocked and then handed over to be run by the customer themselves: it is the host's own report of damage to their own vehicle, and the host performs it in person rather than the desk performing it for them.

### Parameters

- `enrollment_id` — the reference number of the host protection enrolment covering the damaged vehicle, read from the enrolment record retrieved for this host.
- `booking_id` — the reference number of the trip booking the damage is reported against, read from the trip record retrieved for that vehicle.
- `damage_category` — the kind of loss being reported, one of `exterior_body` (dents, scrapes or paint damage to the outside of the vehicle), `interior` (damage to upholstery, trim or fittings inside the cabin), `glass` (a chipped, cracked or shattered windscreen, window or mirror glass), `tyres_wheels` (damage to tyres, rims or wheels), `mechanical` (a mechanical breakdown or driveline failure arising on the trip), `theft_total_loss` (the vehicle was stolen or is damaged beyond economic repair), `missing_equipment` (charge cables, seats, racks or other equipment removed from the vehicle) and `third_party_property` (damage the guest caused to property belonging to someone else).
- `document_count` — how many photographs and supporting items are attached to this report, as a whole number of items, counted as one per file lodged; zero is accepted and means nothing was attached.

### Return

A confirmation line in plain text carrying the reference number the report was filed under on the register, the trip it was lodged against and the number of items attached. Receiving that line means the report now stands on the register and is routed to the protection team; no other output is produced.
